_comment: Copy to repos.json and fill real paths. repos.json is gitignored (local paths).
_version_match: exact → case-insensitive → strip v/V → longest version_lines prefix → else default repo/path + branch_pattern → no fixVersion: default as-is
_branch_pattern: {version} = name without leading v/V. Example: v11.12 → dev/11.12.x
_version_lines: Prefix → inherit repo/path/workspace. Longest match wins ("11." before "1.").
_overrides_match: Per-project summary regex overrides: match.summary is checked before version mapping. First match wins.
